reels.title: Learning Functional Subspaces for Neural Network Compression

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper is a perfect fit for hardware_efficiency (1.17x multiplier). It offers a clear, visual opportunity to explain how neural networks can be compressed by finding 'functional subspaces,' which is highly engaging for our technical yet curious audience.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if you could shrink a massive AI model by 90% without losing a single drop of its intelligence?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: Treating a neural network like a high-resolution image that can be compressed into a 'smart' zip file by only keeping the essential geometric shapes that define the picture.
